note.label: The Decayed State of Liberal Women

precepts.why:
For the last sixty years a war has been waged on the black community, and Esau has been exploiting our weakness. What is the black man's weakness? The black woman. Peter calls her “the weaker vessel”: she is weaker than us. When Satan waged war against Adam, did he come and trick Adam? No. He went through Adam's weakness, the woman, to take Adam down. And the white man understands that too.

That is why God says of the 144 in Revelation 14, “These are they which were not defiled with women”. If our weakness is the woman, the 144's weakness will not be woman. They overcome the very place where Satan took Adam down.

And the woman's weakness is her emotions. She can be manipulated; the white man can trick her. Satan played with Eve's emotions, and she said the serpent beguiled me. Sisters, learn to control your emotions. In the house the sisters get in their feelings; that is their weakness, and our weakness is them.

He says, to destroy the black man I have to destroy the black woman first: make her a liberal, destroy the household, take the man out of it, make her think she doesn't need a man. The white man tricked you, sisters. So many problems in the black community come from no father in the house.

A strong woman and an independent woman are two different things. Our righteous foremothers were strong women: a strong woman builds her husband, keeps the family together, and uses her good job to help her family. An independent woman, the liberal woman, oppresses her husband, argues with him, won't listen to him, and ultimately leaves him seeking happiness. Your grandmother before the sixties was good, but the women from the 1960s until now, the majority of their minds are destroyed. The man who dwells with his wife according to knowledge must know where the weakness lies.

precepts.text: Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them. Your works are what follow you through those gates.
precepts.point: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief. Rest is entered by labour; that is the paradox the wilderness generation never accepted.

note.label: 70 Times 7: The Perfection of Mercy Through Christ

precepts.why:
“For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.” Revelation shows who rests and why: “Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.”

precepts.text: Here are they that keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus: the commandments are the works and Jesus is the faith.
precepts.point: Abraham was justified by works when he offered Isaac; faith wrought with his works and by works was faith made perfect, and he was called the friend of God. By works a man is justified and not by faith only, as Romans 2:13 said, and Rahab was justified by works when she sent the spies out another way. As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

note.label: Navigating Through Paul's Letters: Works Of The Law & Liberty

precepts.why:
“shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.” You cannot show faith without works. You show your faith through your actions, which is keeping the commandments of God. John says it in Revelation: “Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

Keep the commandments, and the faith of Jesus. The faith is one, and the commandments are the works. That is what James said, and what Ezra said: saved by works and by faith.

“Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.” Even the devils, the unclean spirits, believe in God and are afraid of him. “But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?” The vain man is the Christianity follower: faith without works, Calvinism, Protestantism, Catholicism. The saints are marked by both, the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus, and one without the other is dead.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 11 A Time Of Defamation

precepts.why: Who is the great city? “And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city,” See what the great city is: Babylon. “because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.” Babylon the great is talking about the United States of America. So their dead bodies lie in the street of the great city, the United States of America.

How the Bible uses the word wine: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.” Wine and strong drink represent lies, falsehood. God uses the term wine, metaphorically, to symbolize lies.

“And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”: policy is a course or principle of action adopted or proposed by a government, and Babylon is a government. Business shall prosper in his hand. “And he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many.”

This goes back to the Greeks and Romans as well, Esau: they propose peace. Nigeria asked America for help against Boko Haram, and the policy was, accept same-sex marriage if you want our help. In 2016 America dropped 26,171 bombs on seven countries, and then they claim to be establishing peace by instituting democracy, like the police of the world. They said Saddam Hussein had weapons of mass destruction, destroyed him, and then said, we made a mistake. That is the game they play on the public. His mark is his policies.
This shows how the prophets received visions and how they explain things. “I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.”

“Holding the four winds of the earth”: the four winds represent the militaries of the world. When we step outside the wind is blowing, so this wind is not literal wind; it is representative of destruction. “Nor on the sea”: there are militaries on the sea, navies. “To whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea”: that is the proof it is talking about destruction. “Till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads”: we have to be sealed with the laws of God and the testimony. All Israelites say I’m sealed with the law until test time comes; then the Most High separates the men from the boys and the women from the girls. We shall through much tribulation enter into the kingdom. Nobody is sneaking into the kingdom; you got to earn this by righteousness. “There were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel”: these are the leaders.

What is the seal of the living God? “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples”: the seal is his testimony and the law. Back in the day, in a video from 1993, I was saying it was the shield of David, and we all walked around with the hexagram; that is not what the seal is talking about.

This goes with Isaiah 8:16 and Revelation 7 regarding the seal in the foreheads. “With the house of Israel and with the house of Judah”: because we were split into two kingdoms. “Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers”: not according to animal sacrifice; that was the old covenant. “And I regarded them not”: he sent us into captivity. “I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts”: that’s the point; that is what being sealed in our foreheads means. Verse 11, “And they shall not teach every man his neighbour,” is clearly talking about the kingdom. People try to say verse 11 is for today; it’s not for today.
The precept for Hebrews 8:11. “And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord”: that goes back to when the scriptures say Christ will deal with us face to face. That’s the kingdom.

This ties in with the numbskulls that say nobody knows who the twelve tribes are or who Judah is. “The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first”: Judah is going to be the first of the tribes to wake up and get the understanding of who they are. That is why Revelation 7 names Judah first.

What is Judah going to do once they get the knowledge? “Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah”: Judah is going to teach. “And bring him unto his people”: in order to bring Judah to his people, Judah got to know who his people are: that’s Benjamin over there, that’s Levi, that’s Simeon, that’s Ephraim. His people would be scattered in all nations, and Judah would be the one going to them. “Let his hands be sufficient for him”: Judah is always going to be at a fight against the enemy, particularly Edom. “And be thou an help to him from his enemies.”

Hold Deuteronomy 33:7. “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations”: people read that and lose their minds, but the New Testament is not separate from the Old Testament. The two go hand in hand; you just got to put the pieces of the puzzle together.

This uses the word that Matthew 28:19 used. “And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations”: this is a curse upon the twelve tribes. “And ye shall be left few in number”: because they were killing a lot of us. So Judah would have to know these are Israelites here, this is that tribe, this is that tribe; we might not know a tribe yet, but it is coming, and we are going to teach him anyway. That’s what is going on right now.

“Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand.” “After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations”: between the sealing and the destruction you have men, women and children coming into this truth. “Clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands.”

“Behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of the Lord”: that’s the 144,000 of Revelation 7:4. “Which are departed from the shadow of the world”: which is sin. “Take thy number, O Sion”: it is telling you who they are; Sion is another name for Israelites. “Which have fulfilled the law of the Lord”: when you see Israelites not keeping the law, if they cannot apply basic law, love your neighbour as yourself, get away from them. “The number of thy children, whom thou longedst for, is fulfilled”: Christ said when this gospel shall be preached in all the world, then shall the end come. You think everybody has to hear it; it ain’t talking about that. When the 144,000 is reached, that’s it. When the last one is sealed, then destruction comes.

“I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number”: this is saying the same thing as Revelation 7:9. “And in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest”: it calls him a young man because he died in his early thirties, and he is going to come back with that same body. “It is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world.” “Them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord”: the name of the Lord refers to his law and his testimony.

Christ is the one that crowns them. “And if a man also strive for masteries”: the mastery we are all striving for is to be part of the elect. “Yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully”: the operative word is lawfully. If you think you are going to slander your way to a crown, or shuck and jive your way to a crown, that ain’t happening with the Most High. How do you know if you are striving lawfully? There are going to be tests from the Lord; test that brother, test that sister, test them as a congregation.

Every week we get an email about a new name of God. “Him that overcometh”: overcomes your own personal sins, your trials in your marriage, your trials amongst the congregation. “Will I make a pillar in the temple of my God”: to be a pillar means a leader. “And he shall go no more out”: not going out into captivity no more. “And I will write upon him the name of my God”: when you overcome. Check YouTube and you’ll see every camp with a different name, and they’ll all condemn you to death if you don’t say it; I used to do it. We are still here in captivity; what are you talking about, you overcame already?

This is why the Israelite camps hate us. Some brothers say Yahawah, some say Ahayah, some say Yahweh; I ain’t arguing with none of y’all. “My determination is to gather the nations”: God says I do want all nations together, to destroy them. “To pour upon them mine indignation.” “For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent”: once he destroys the nations and their militaries, then he will give us the pure language. It is going to be one name and one pronunciation. I’m not the most educated brother in Israel, but I can read basic English; it said then. You got the pure language already? So you bypassed God’s prophecies? Reading is fundamental.

This new song the Christian church don’t sing; you sing this and everybody says you got the devil on you. “And his praise in the congregation of saints”: the next verse proves the saints are Israel, not all races on the planet. “Let Israel rejoice in him that made him”: the problem with our people is we have been rejoicing in Esau. You prove who you rejoice in by the holidays you keep. If you celebrate Christmas, Thanksgiving, Easter, New Year’s, Valentine’s Day, even Kwanzaa, you are rejoicing in the devil, because God did not establish them. He established the Sabbath, Passover, the feast of unleavened bread, the feast of weeks, the memorial of blowing of trumpets, the day of atonement, the feast of tabernacles, the feast of dedication; if you ain’t keeping them days, you are rejoicing in the devil. “Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King”: we got to acknowledge we do have a king. Eye hath not seen what God hath prepared for them that love him; Thor, Krypton, the elf kingdom in Lord of the Rings, that’s ghetto compared to what he’s setting up here on earth. “Let them praise his name in the dance”: people get mad when we dance; we going to dance. “For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people”: not all nations. “Let the high praises of God be in their mouth”: his laws, the law and the testimony. “And a twoedged sword in their hand; To execute vengeance upon the heathen”: vengeance ain’t words; vengeance is actions. Another word for it is payback, retribution, justice, and we have never seen justice in today’s society. “To bind their kings with chains.” “To execute upon them the judgment written”: we are not going by our own mind; we do exactly what the written judgment says. “This honour have all his saints.” If we bring the right understanding of this scripture out in the media, we will be crucified.

“Which were redeemed from the earth.” “O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee”: who did he redeem? Jacob, Israel, the same people. “I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.” The ones redeemed from the earth is Israel.

“And I find more bitter than death the woman”: let’s see what type of woman. Some brothers bring it out like God hates all women; that is not what he is saying. “Whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands”: this is the type of woman some of you are married to. She don’t want you to do nothing with the scriptures: why you always with the brothers, why you always in the Bible, why you always got to go to camp? I asked a brother one time do you have peace at home with your wife; he said yes, as long as we don’t open the Bible. “Whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her”: if you want to please the Lord, get away from her.

Being defiled by women is an allegory, a similitude, in terms of philosophies; the first philosophy came through Eve, and we all die. “And sit not in the midst of women.” “For from garments cometh a moth, and from women wickedness”: the Most High knows what he made.

Your two main obstacles in striving to become part of the elect are going to be money and women; every problem we counsel comes back to those two. “Let go from thee mortal thoughts, cast away the burdens of man, put off now the weak nature”: it is talking about sin, and you know what you are weak to. “And set aside the thoughts that are most heavy unto thee”: money and women; put them thoughts aside. “And haste thee to flee from these times.”

Read this history on your own: Athaliah set herself up as queen, killing all the sons that were to be set on the throne; Israel hid one son until he could be revealed as king, and Athaliah had an army. “Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword”: they didn’t play. The Most High don’t deal with weak-natured men following women. “For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the Lord.” The scriptures are meant to transform you from one man into another; that is part of why we set up the Men of Valor program.

People say rank is evil; rank is your place in the kingdom. “Which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel”: there’s no gate called Negro Baptist or Puerto Rican Catholic; you got to come through one of the gates. “And in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb”: the twelve apostles are part of the 144,000, but they are the top of it.

“Ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel”: that’s rank right there. Christ is going to give the twelve the order, they are going to give the rest of the 144,000 the orders, and we will all obey. There ain’t going to be no confusion.

This shows that being a virgin is not talking about sex, because Peter is the top of the apostles. “But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever”: Simon Peter had a wife. Peter the apostle was married.

The real understanding of being a virgin: “For I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.” A chaste virgin means pure, undefiled; if it ain’t talking about sex, it is talking about philosophies and sin.
“These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth.” “Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me.”

This is the main one. “He goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice”: Christ is talking about himself. “And a stranger will they not follow”: they are not following strange doctrines and strange philosophies.
“My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me”: that is what it means to follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth.
“These were redeemed from among men.” “And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men.”

“Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man”: there is a divine order; the Most High deals with men first and foremost. The women that love the Lord are going to fall in line with that; those with the Jezebel spirit are going to be angry and say why aren’t we equal, the white man says we’re equal. That’s not what God says.

What does being the firstfruits mean? We have a high holy day called firstfruits. “That we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures”: when we wake up to this truth we are a kind of firstfruits; not a literal firstfruit like an apple or an orange. That’s how the Lord sees us that come into his truth.
Rank in the Old Testament: “Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates.”

For those who say that’s not the New Testament: “That thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city”: to ordain an elder means there must be a ranking system. Bishops, deacons and captains are elders. The Mormons ride around on bicycles with Elder on their name tags and nobody has a problem with that, but when our people set up rank and structure, it’s evil.

This is what you men don’t want to be. When we started off it was three families, boots on the ground; we didn’t drag people from old congregations with us. You’re not a teacher of God if you have to steal, trick or beguile people to follow you. “Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them”: if you have to draw away disciples after you, you are not of the elect; you are a deceiver, a traitor, a defector, a derelict, treacherous.
“Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile”: that’s what the Lord is looking for from every man and every woman. Don’t let your mouth speak guile.

“Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile”: malice is the intention or desire to do evil: ill will, spite, hostility, hatred, bitterness, vindictiveness, revenge, backbiting, rancour, grudge. “As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word.”

This is how all of us must be; we cannot have guile, deceit, trickery or craftiness in our mouth. “Let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile”: these are things we must put in practice. It’s not enough just reading it; when you are tempted to speak evil, close your lips. “But the face of the Lord is against them that do evil”: all you men and women who ran out of here and are speaking evil now, the Lord is against you. That’s not something I wrote; I’m reading the scriptures.

“Without fault before the throne of God.” “Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory”: all this is of the Lord; he presents us faultless.

Paul explains how we can become faultless in this truth. “Who walk not after the flesh”: after guile, deceit, treachery and evil, “but after the Spirit”: the laws of God. That’s how we are found faultless, without condemnation; walk in the spirit.

precepts.why: Works and faith is the same thing John said: “Here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

“I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth”: the four winds represent the destruction coming from the militaries of the earth. The angels were given power “to hurt the earth and the sea”; that is the operative word. Regular wind ain’t hurting the earth, so this hurt is talking about destruction, major destruction.

“And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God”: the seal of the living God is the testimonies and the laws. “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.”

“And there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” Not all nations are being saved: this is only for the elect, and the 144,000 are the leaders of the twelve tribes of Israel. Of Judah, of Reuben, of Gad were sealed twelve thousand: so we would have to have some idea of who the tribes of Israel are. People say nobody knows who the tribes are; then how would Reuben get sealed? Or else we would be sitting among the Chinese and the Japanese. We know the curses upon the Israelites would be colonialism and slavery; we start there.

“Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” We are being sealed with the law. It is not enough just to talk about God’s laws; we must apply God’s law. Study, pray, apply: SPA. No matter how difficult it gets, we must do this thing.

“For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind”. That is what we are being sealed with: God’s laws. If you are in here and you don’t believe you have to keep God’s laws, you are in the wrong place.

Those being sealed are not only this generation. Generations before us knew this knowledge, not to the level we have now. This deals with time and understanding. “Behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward”: the waters are the word of God.

“He measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.” The understanding of the word of God was only to the ankles. “Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees”: the understanding of God’s laws came to the knees. Then to the loins. When I came in as a youth, the only law we kept was the beard law; we fellowshipped on the sabbath but still cooked on the sabbath, still bought and sold on the sabbath, and the women wore a dress one day a week.

“And it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in”: a time will come when the word of God will fill the earth. Our ancestors who preceded us weren’t where we are today, and the Most High is going to judge them based on the understanding they had at that time, not the same understanding the brothers have today, because it wasn’t open to them.

What are the waters a similitude of? “That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word”. The word of God is the water. Even in the ministry of John the Baptist, the water was symbolic, a similitude; it had no power.

Why do people want to get dipped in water? Because they are wicked as hell. Growing up we went through seven different churches and got baptized seven different times, and it did us no good; we were wicked as hell. She wants to lay in the water and come up, shazam, all holy ghost filled, because she doesn’t want to do what it says. If you were baptized in God’s laws you would show changing.

“Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.” That is what David prayed, and every generation has to pray it. Read four chapters a day and within a year you will have read the entire Bible; by the second and third year you will pick up things you never saw before, though you read them a million times.

“And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah”: because Judah would be the teachers. “And bring him unto his people”: for the Lord to bring Judah to his people, Judah must have an idea who the tribes of Israel are. So don’t let people fool you that nobody knows who they are; that is a lie.

“After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues”: people say that means everybody. No: Revelation 7:9 is talking about those that went into slavery, scattered among all nations. 2 Esdras 2 shows who this great multitude is.

“Behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of the Lord”: the number of those sealed is 144,000. Ezra is saying the same thing John the Revelator was saying. “Which are departed from the shadow of the world”: departed from sin. “And have received glorious garments of the Lord”: the white robes.

“Take thy number, O Sion”: Sion is another name for Israel. “And shut up those of thine that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of the Lord.” That verifies what the sealing is: it ain’t saying fulfill the hexagram, it ain’t saying fulfill your sexual desire; fulfill the law of the Lord. Study, pray, apply.

“The number of thy children, whom thou longedst for, is fulfilled”: that is the 144. “That thy people, which have been called from the beginning, may be hallowed”: called from the beginning of time, when we were with the Lord in the heavens and he said you will be chosen as my elect, and this group over here will play the devil on earth. We came down into these fleshly bodies, and we are just fulfilling our roles.

“I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number”: this is Revelation 7:9, and it says on mount Sion, that is Israel. “And they all praised the Lord with songs.”

“Therefore, behold, I will allure her”: the her is the nation of Israel, the elect, not all Israel; two out of three of Israel, the Bible says, must die. Allure means to be powerfully attractive, to entice, seduce, persuade. How is the Lord alluring us? With his word, his laws: this is the attraction, the persuasion. “And bring her into the wilderness”: Ezekiel 20, the wilderness of the people. “And speak comfortably unto her”: he will speak to us face to face and teach us everything from Genesis and beyond.

“And she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt”: we are going to sing when we get the lands of inheritance. “Thou shalt call me Ishi”: Ishi means husband; we will call the Lord our husband. “And shalt call me no more Baali”: Baali translates as my Lord.

“For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.” Whatever language we speak, and whatever name we use to identify the one true God, he is going to take all that away. All the names we have for the Most High God are not pure.

“For then will I turn to the people a pure language”: the operative word is pure. The Hebrew Israelite camps always go to Esau’s Strong’s Concordance and Ben Yehuda’s Hebrew dictionary; it is not pure, the Bible says it is not pure. And the groups that don’t believe in Christ go to the Hebrew to argue that he never existed and there was no J in Hebrew, to get you confused.

“That they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent”: that is not today. Google the names of God and you will find over ten, everybody arguing. It sounds nice, but it ain’t pure, because the Bible says it ain’t pure.

Here is the proper precept for having the Father’s name written in their foreheads. “Him that overcometh”: overcome your own sins, your trials and tribulations, individual, marital or congregational. “Will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out”: you ain’t going into captivity no more.

“And I will write upon him the name of my God”: he will give you the pure language, the Father’s pure name, when you overcome. People say, no Lord, I got it already, my elder taught me the name. Reading is fundamental.

This goes with the name. “And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.” What is his name? The Word of God. People want a special shazam name that gives them goosebumps; his name is called the Word of God.

Redeemed from the earth: “But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name”. Notice that the 144 are not going to bug out on a name; they are going to teach the word of God and keep it moving. 2 Esdras says those that were sealed fulfilled the law, not the name.

An example of the new song. “Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song”. I dare any of you to find a negro singing this, and if negroes ain’t singing it, the Latinos definitely ain’t singing it.

This is included in the new song. “Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand; To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people”. Find me a church alive today singing about getting vengeance on their enemies. The black woman is in the church humming, but she ain’t humming that: not my Jesus, not my white Jesus.

“To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron”: show me a church talking about putting our enemies in yokes of iron. There is no gospel song on earth singing that, from Catholicism to Baptist to Lutheran, Pentecostal, Seventh-day Adventist, Jehovah’s Witness. They are not singing the new song, because they are not of the elect.

“Behold not every body’s beauty, and sit not in the midst of women.” Two types of men hang around groups of women: hungry brothers, because they are trying to get the cookies, and homos, who want your beauty secrets, how you do your makeup, your hair, your nails. Too much hand gesture; if your hands are on your hip you better be tired. “For from garments cometh a moth, and from women wickedness.”

This is not talking about all women in general, because women are part of the elect in the great multitude; this is a particular type of woman God can’t stand. “And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets”: her mind is always trying to figure a way to trap you away from the body, to keep you from applying the Bible. She nags you, threatens you, is always in your ear. “And her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her”: this is for the elect; if you want to please the Lord, get the hell away from her. Some of you brothers are scared to bust a move, so you stay with that banshee: a female spirit wailing, warning of an impending death in the house. You walk through the door and here she comes, so you sit in the bar from sun up to sun down.

Remember Adam’s sin: he listened to his wife. Satan said, I can’t come direct to him; if I go through her, he might listen. That’s why the scripture says she is the weaker vessel.

This is for you mama’s boys. “Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword.” God can’t use a man that follows a woman. The order is God, Christ, man, then woman. If a man has a woman as his counselor, there is something wrong with his spirit, and God ain’t using him. This is training time, rehearsal: fix it now.

The precept for they are virgins: “For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.” We are the female, as in Hosea where the Lord says I will allure her. We are the virgins because all our sins have been wiped away. This is not the fake thing women do on the news, putting in an artificial hymen; that is evil and that is the devil.

This is what he means by virgins. “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit”: who walk not after sin, but after the law in Christ. That is how we are a chaste virgin, because we are doing our best to walk in these laws, and this is how we are without fault before the throne.

“My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me”. Following the Lamb means wherever the shepherd leads, we follow. “And I give unto them eternal life”. Christ is not on earth walking with us, so we follow him by doing whatever the Bible says.

This is what the whole group out in Texas that left got mad at. “Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.” They say, no, I’m grown, you can’t tell me who to talk to. Then you are not of the elect; you do not follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth.

“And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.” If they don’t want to hear the congregation, let them be as heathens and publicans; and Israel did not deal with the heathens and publicans. He’ll say something and you’ll reject it: then you don’t follow Christ wherever he goes.

“Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee”: that is somebody close to you, somebody you love. “Cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.” Romans 16:17, Matthew 18:17 and Matthew 18:8: you don’t want to do what this Bible says, so you are not of the elect, and you look at us like we are the devil.

Some of the two thirds come through these doors and are sitting in the seats right now. “Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven”: they say Lord, Lord because they may be in camps, they know they are Israel. All you Israelites ain’t getting into the kingdom of heaven. “But he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven”: he that follows the Lamb whithersoever he goes.

“Have we not prophesied in thy name?” We used to be in the streets teaching that Israelite stuff, we did videos for you, Lord. “And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.” There comes a burnout: your spirit loses interest in the word of God, you get tired of discipline day after day, you lean toward adultery, toward sin, you join with the brother you know is the devil, the beard comes off. Know your spirit.

“Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.” When we come into this truth we are a kind of firstfruits. The firstfruits were the best of your crops, the first and best.

The souls of men and women who have dedicated themselves to this truth are the firstfruits. “Ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints”. Not addicted to weed, crack cocaine, porn, gluttony or video games: the only thing we are to be addicted to is the ministry of the saints.

People speak great words and you follow after the great words, but that is not what the scripture says. “Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone”. The scripture says you and him alone; a recorder makes a third. So that man has not followed the Lamb wherever he goes: these are not the elect.

Without fault: “Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy”. When we repent of our sins and the Lord knows we are rehearsing the righteous acts, he will present us faultless, and he will do it with exceeding joy, because as servants we have followed the Lamb whithersoever he went: whatever he said, we studied, we prayed, we applied.
“And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen”: few, because they were killing us.

“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other”: the Israelites scattered among all people. “And there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone”: Christianity and Islam, the world’s two largest religions. That is the evidence that the Israelites would be scattered from one end of the earth to the other.

Here is more proof. “And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.” Where did these Jews come from? Out of every nation under heaven. How did they get to every nation? Through slavery, Deuteronomy 28:64 and Deuteronomy 4:27. So every nation, kindred and tongue in Revelation 14:6 is where the Israelites were scattered.

What is the hour of his judgment? “Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” That great city Babylon is America. “And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her”: they got wealthy dealing in America’s trade and commerce, buying and selling, and they lament “when they shall see the smoke of her burning”.

“For in one hour so great riches is come to nought.” That is why the scriptures say what shall it profit a man if he gain the whole world and lose his soul. Everybody wants to be rich, the next Jay-Z, the next Beyoncé; what is it going to profit you when this day comes? All that money comes to nothing. “And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off”: trade goes back to buying and selling.

“Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.” In one hour this place is going to be destroyed: ashes to ashes, dust to dust. That is why we ain’t got time to play with y’all.

“Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world”. That hour of temptation is the hour of judgment, that destruction.

To explain wine: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine”. Wine is a similitude, a metaphor for lies, for falsehood. This is where the spirit of discernment comes in: in some scriptures wine means literal wine, and in others, like the book of Revelation, it is a similitude for lies.
“For the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication”. Idolatry is spiritual fornication. So Babylon made all nations drink of the lies of the wrath of her spiritual fornication.
Who is the beast? “And behold a great red dragon”. God didn’t put that adjective there for no reason. People read the great red dragon and think there are monsters in it; stop.
“I am a brother to dragons”: dragons are wicked people. That is what Job says.
Who is the red brother? “And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.” That is the so-called white man, the Caucasian race.

What is his image? The Bible explains it. “And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles”: the verse above talks about the dropping of the atom bombs. “Which he had power to do in the sight of the beast”: the beast is his European allies. “That they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: an image to the white man. Rome fell in 193 AD, and came back in power around 1453, the Renaissance era.

“And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast”: they took the image from Rome, Caesar Borgia, the second son of Pope Alexander VI, and said this image shall now be called Jesus Christ. “That the image of the beast should both speak”: they find actors who look like Caesar Borgia to speak the words of Christ.

“And cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.” That is history. A sister with a talk show in Sierra Leone said nobody was killed for not worshipping the white image of Jesus; how little you know. Look at the king at the stake: the Jesuit priest held the cross with the white image of Jesus and told him if he worshipped the image he might go to heaven. He asked the priest where he would go when he died; the devil said heaven; and he said then I’d rather go to hell. They forced white-supremacy Christianity on us.

What is the mark? “To receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: And that no man might buy or sell”. That lets you know the mark deals with economics, trade and commerce, traffic, doing business. It is not talking about a negro selling a Snickers bar or buying a KitKat; it is big business, corporations, Wall Street. “Save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.”

Who dictates buying and selling? The IMF, the International Monetary Fund, and the World Bank, right across the street from each other in Washington DC, and the New York Stock Exchange.

What they are selling: “And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her”. Merchants is not a modern word; the word for merchants today is corporations. “The merchandise of gold”: the negro ain’t selling gold, or silver. Most of these things come from the continent of Africa, and Central and South America too.

points: “And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen”: America is fallen, is fallen. “That great city”: that great kingdom. “Because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: she made all nations drink of her policies, her false policies. America is not having sex, but she is in bed with all these other countries. It is all a metaphor.

“If any man worship the beast and his image”: the operative word is worship. People say that is the Statue of Liberty; it is more than that, it goes into religion. The image is the image America and all her allies push for worship.

“And receive his mark in his forehead”: the mark goes back to his policies, and to the wine, the falsehood and lies. In the forehead: you believe those policies, you trust in them. “Or in his hand”: you support those policies with your hand. You will go to war for them; you stand and salute the flag with your hand. God bless America.

“The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God”: John prophesies that you will be punished by the Lord of heaven and earth for that. “Which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation”: his indignation is righteous anger. “And he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb”: that is the thermonuclear destruction the Bible also calls the lake of fire.

“And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever”: write down Isaiah 34:10, where Isaiah sees the fall of Babylon the great and the smoke of that place goes up for ever. “And they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name”: the mark of his name is still his policies. A lot of times we think we can escape punishment by death; you cannot escape the Lord.

Satan’s agenda is to cause you men to forget the mission and be distracted; we must not stop teaching and raising up our people because of foolishness, evil speech, gossip and slander. This is John the Revelator, exiled on the island of Patmos in a salt mine, seeing things. When you read the Book of Revelation, understand that the explanation of the visions and similitudes was not given to John; it is given to us now in these last days. “And, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion”: the Lamb represents Christ. John the Baptist said, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world. “And with him an hundred forty and four thousand”: there is a doctrine going around that we don’t know definitively who the tribes of Israel are. “Having his Father’s name written in their foreheads”: why? Because they overcame their trials and tribulations.

“And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters”: many waters means loud. “And I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps”: don’t ask me who the harpers are; that is in heaven, above my pay grade.

“And they sung as it were a new song before the throne”: we went over the song of the Lamb and the song of Moses. “And before the four beasts, and the elders”: don’t ask me who the four beasts or the elders in heaven are either. “And no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand”: these are teachers; these are the ones that can learn the song and take you precept upon precept, line upon line, here a little and there a little. This is why we tell you men to study. “Which were redeemed from the earth.”

“These are they which were not defiled with women”: it don’t mean what you are thinking. The Lord deals with women, everything in his proper order: he dealt with our foremothers Sarah and Rebekah, and with Huldah, who knew the scriptures very well, but they were not setting themselves up as leaders over the men. “For they are virgins”: it does not mean they never had sex; it means undefiled with philosophies and sin. “These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth”: whatever the scriptures say to do, the sheep, the elect, are going to do it, no excuses, no matter how hard. That’s why there must be tests: we all say we love the Lord, and your trial proves whether you love the Lord or not. “These were redeemed from among men”: the 144,000 of men. “Being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.”

“And in their mouth was found no guile”: guile is sly or cunning intelligence: craftiness, artfulness, deviousness, wiles, ploys, schemes, stratagems, manoeuvres, subterfuges, tricks, ruses, deception, deceit, duplicity, underhandedness, double dealing, treachery, fraud. Think about all that we have been going through at IUIC in the past couple of months; it all fits. The elect is not going to have guile in their mouth, and all them videos you see on YouTube can be put in one word: guile. Men who left say they’re still in the truth, but their classes are not edifying anybody; they are all personal attacks, saying the ranking system is evil. Rank has been set up from the beginning; a rank is a title for order’s sake, and your rank is based upon your works. Everything in existence has an order: the sun comes out in the day, the moon at night, the water doesn’t go beyond the shoreline. Rank and order are synonymous; when you are against rank you are against order, and the Bible calls that disorderly. God deals with order: angels, archangels, Christ above all, and the Father; in First Corinthians, God, the Son, man, woman and child. “For they are without fault before the throne of God”: this is what we are trying to attain.
“And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand”: this continues from last week, when Revelation 7 was gone through. Mount Sion is Israel.

“Having his Father’s name written in their foreheads”: every week an email comes in with a new name of God. Everybody is arguing with everybody, condemning you if you don’t say it the way their camp says it; two camps in Texas almost got into a fist fight over the name of the Most High. Israelites are turning into Bloods and Crips over a name. But the scripture says the Father’s name is written on them when they overcome: he is going to give us the pure language, that we may all call upon the Lord with one consent, when he allures us into the wilderness. So in IUIC we don’t bug out on the name. If a brother says Yahawah or Yahawashi or Yahweh, there is nothing wrong with that; don’t bug out on it.

“And they sung as it were a new song before the throne”: the elect sing the song of Moses and the song of the Lamb. It is none of these gospel songs you hear today, Kirk Franklin or James Cleveland; that is not the new song. It gives you goosebumps, but it ain’t the word of God; it just makes you feel good.

“And no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand”: the 144,000 will be teachers. They are the leaders, able to teach precept upon precept, line upon line, here a little and there a little, like nobody else. Only the 144 will be able to learn that song. “Which were redeemed from the earth.”

“These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins”: if you are under your woman’s skirt, you are not of the elect; God can’t use you. We are the virgins because all our sins have been wiped away clean; we are the female, the her of Hosea 2 that the Lord allures.

“These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth”: everybody says I follow the Lamb wherever he goes; you are a liar. Christ is not on earth walking with us, so how do we follow him? Whatever the Bible says, we are going to do. Wherever the Lamb takes us we will obey, even if it hurts, even if we love a brother or a sister so much: because the King said it, I must let you go. That is what the elect will say and apply.

“These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb”: think of the high holy days in Leviticus 23, the feast of firstfruits. The firstfruits were the first and best of your crops; the souls of men and women who have dedicated themselves to this truth are the firstfruits, and you will never know until the end.

“And in their mouth was found no guile”: look the word up. Guile is sly or cunning intelligence, craftiness, deviousness, schemes, tricks, ruses, deception, deceit, double-dealing, treachery. You are trying to be slick, scheming, underhanded. That is calling the head of the organization and saying, I would like to apply Matthew 18, and I am going to record you, and a whole group of idiots ran behind that. You wouldn’t go to Christ and say, I have to record you just in case you lie. Matthew 18:15 says tell him his fault between thee and him alone; recording him is not what the scripture says, so you have not followed the Lamb wherever he goes.

“For they are without fault before the throne of God”: how are they without fault? Romans 8:1: “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.”

“And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people”: there you go, people say, it’s for everybody. No. It is saying the same thing Revelation 7:9 said: the gospel is preached to the Israelites scattered among every nation. When you read all nations, your mind goes to democracy, everybody; you have already omitted the prophecies and the histories of God, and gone to the white man. That is where your mind automatically goes, in Satan. This is why the Old Testament and the New Testament go hand in hand; once you separate the old from the new, you are lost in confusion.

“Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him”: no matter what we do, eating or sleeping, we must always give him glory, honor and praise. “For the hour of his judgment is come”: the Lord prophesied we were going into slavery, and it happened; he says in one hour his judgment will come, and you better believe that is going to happen too. Everything he said has come to pass thus far. If you believe some of the Bible but not all of it, this ain’t for you.

In Liberia a whole church was singing for three hours, songs some negro made up in his house, not biblical songs. Two people raised their hands when asked who has a Bible, and when asked what they learned that day, crickets. Is that what the Lord is looking for?

“Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city”: Babylon means confusion, and this would be the top nation on earth. When God raised up Egypt as the superpower they were mentioned, ancient Babylon was mentioned, Persia and Media were mentioned, the Greeks and the Romans were mentioned; but in these last days America, the mightiest nation on earth, is not mentioned? Babylon the great, that mighty city, is the United States of America.

“Because she made all nations drink of the wine”: wine here is a similitude for lies. “Of the wrath of her fornication”: fornication is not America running around having sex; it is spiritual fornication, idolatry. She made all nations drink of the lies of the wrath of her spiritual fornication. What does America do to deceive all nations? She has political and economic policies set up to keep all nations in check.

“If any man worship the beast and his image”: the beast is the great red dragon, Esau, the so-called white man, the Caucasian race. His image is the image of Caesar Borgia, which they took from Rome as the new image of Christ to be worshipped.

“And receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand”: your forehead, because you believe it, your brain is in your forehead; your hand, because you support it. The mark deals with economics, trade and commerce. If any country says to America, I don’t agree with your policy, before they kill you they put a sanction on you, the individual, or an embargo on your entire country, and you are cut off from everything. This is why Africa is so afraid: the European allies have made a pact that they will not buy from them or sell to them.

“The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God”: does wine here mean the lies of the wrath of God? No; this is why precept must be upon precept, rightly dividing the word of truth. This cup of wine is judgment, and we know who is going to drink it: Edom. Babylon made all nations drink of the wine of her fornication, and Babylon is Edom.
“And he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb”: that is some death right there.

“And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image”: you keep on worshipping that white man, you keep on staying in Christianity, “and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name”: you accept his political policies. There is a spiritual world: when some are translated, they are going to suffer major punishment. Nobody is getting away with nothing. When the bombs hit this place it is going to be like a lake of fire, and their spirits will be held in that fire. Fire is spirit; that is why the angel asked Ezra the weight of a flame.

“Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” The key word is patience: we must patiently do what it says, because we get sick and tired sometimes of disciplining ourselves day after day. We wake up with evil on our minds, and through the day our minds start to wander.

“Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth”: this is a heavy verse; we don’t like talking about death. When brothers worry about traveling to other countries, anything could pop off: if we die, blessed are they that die in the Lord; keep pushing the truth. The Most High could take us out any time, anywhere in the world.

“That they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them”: the labors men and women do in this truth are for the Most High, not for pay from man. When a brother or sister dies, don’t bug out and say they must have been the devil. Tabitha died with good works; today they would say it was a blood sacrifice. Black people don’t read their Bible. The sister on the cruise jumped out of bed, screamed and fell down, and nothing could be done; she had a good report, and nobody found anything wicked to say about her. Her time was up.

“And I looked, and behold a white cloud”: a cloud chariot. Some of you have Greek mythology in your head and think Christ sits on a puff of smoke. “And upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.”
“Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.” This is all death and destruction for the wicked.

“Gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe”, and they are cast “into the great winepress of the wrath of God.” Blood comes out of the winepress “even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs”: there is going to be so much death and destruction in the valley of decision.

The grapes gathered and smashed in the winepress are not the elect. It says gather: remember in Joel 3 he is going to gather the nations, and Zephaniah says his determination is to gather the nations, that he may pour upon them the fierceness of his anger.
